```{r}
#| label: setup
# Built by the codebook skill (ai_skills/codebook). Reads data-dict.yaml and
#   the parquet file it names, both in this folder. Counts below
#   params$suppress_n are shown as "<n" and their bars are not drawn;
#   minimum and maximum are never shown.
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
source("theme_intern.R")
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x   # base R has it only from 4.4

k <- params$suppress_n
dict <- yaml::read_yaml("data-dict.yaml")
tbl <- dict$tables[[1]]
dat <- nanoparquet::read_parquet(tbl$source$parquet)
cols <- set_names(tbl$columns, map_chr(tbl$columns, "name"))

# "small" (1 to k-1), "protect" (hidden only so a small cell cannot be
#   worked out from the total; may be large) or "" (shown).
hide_reason <- function(n) {
  small <- n > 0 & n < k
  others <- which(!small & n > 0)
  out <- rep("", length(n))
  if (sum(small) == 1L && length(others)) out[others[which.min(n[others])]] <- "protect"
  out[small] <- "small"
  out
}
suppress <- function(n) hide_reason(n) != ""
fmt_n <- function(n) format(n, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
field <- function(col, name) col[[name]] %||% ""
```

## About the data

`r dict$description %||% tbl$description %||% "*No description yet: see the open questions below.*"`

**`r fmt_n(nrow(dat))` rows and `r ncol(dat)` columns.** All counts in this
codebook are unweighted counts of records, not population estimates. Counts
below `r k` are shown as "<`r k`", one further cell is hidden where needed so
they cannot be recovered from totals, and minimum and maximum values are not
shown.

## Variables

```{r}
#| label: variables
overview <- map_dfr(names(dat), function(v) {
  x <- dat[[v]]
  miss <- sum(is.na(x))
  col <- cols[[v]] %||% list()
  small <- miss > 0 && miss < k
  # With the row count known, an exact valid count would reveal a
  #   suppressed missing count, so it is shown as a bound too.
  tibble(Variable = v,
         Label = field(col, "label"),
         Type = field(col, "type"),
         Valid = if (small) paste0(">", fmt_n(nrow(dat) - k)) else fmt_n(sum(!is.na(x))),
         Missing = if (small) paste0("<", k) else fmt_n(miss),
         Description = field(col, "description"))
})
knitr::kable(overview)
```

## Missing values

```{r}
#| label: fig-missing
#| fig-cap: "Share of records missing each variable."
#| fig-alt: "Dot plot of the share of missing values for each variable, sorted from most to least missing."
miss <- tibble(variable = names(dat), n = map_int(dat, \(x) sum(is.na(x)))) |>
  mutate(hidden = n > 0 & n < k, share = n / nrow(dat))
shown <- filter(miss, !hidden)
hidden_vars <- miss$variable[miss$hidden]
ggplot(shown, aes(share, reorder(variable, share))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = share, yend = reorder(variable, share)), colour = "grey80") +
  geom_point(colour = okabe_ito[["blue"]], size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "Share missing", y = NULL,
       title = if (any(shown$n > 0)) "Some variables have missing values" else "No variable has missing values above the threshold",
       caption = if (length(hidden_vars))
         paste0("Fewer than ", k, " missing, not drawn: ", paste(hidden_vars, collapse = ", "), ".")) +
  theme_intern(grid = "x")
```

## Each variable

```{r}
#| label: alt-text
# One alt text per chart drawn below, in order (knitr applies fig-alt to the
#   plots of a chunk in sequence), so each needs the same test as the plot.
categorical <- function(x) is.character(x) || is.logical(x) || is.factor(x)
draws_plot <- function(v) {
  x <- dat[[v]]
  if (identical(cols[[v]]$display, "restricted")) return(FALSE)
  if (categorical(x)) {
    n <- table(as.character(x), useNA = "no")
    return(any(!suppress(as.integer(n))))
  }
  is.numeric(x) && sum(!is.na(x)) >= k
}
alts <- map_chr(keep(names(dat), draws_plot), function(v)
  if (categorical(dat[[v]])) paste0("Bar chart of the number of records in each category of ", v, ".")
  else paste0("Histogram of ", v, ", bins with fewer than ", k, " records not drawn."))
```

```{r}
#| label: each-variable
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 2.6
#| fig-alt: !expr alts

plot_categorical <- function(x, v) {
  counts <- tibble(level = as.character(x)) |>
    filter(!is.na(level)) |>
    count(level) |>
    mutate(reason = hide_reason(n), hidden = reason != "")
  hide_text <- (cols[[v]]$type %||% "") != "enum"
  drawn <- filter(counts, !hidden)
  name_them <- function(r) if (hide_text) paste0(sum(counts$reason == r), " value(s)")
    else paste(counts$level[counts$reason == r], collapse = ", ")
  note <- paste(c(
    if (any(counts$reason == "small"))
      paste0("Not drawn, fewer than ", k, " records: ", name_them("small"), "."),
    if (any(counts$reason == "protect"))
      paste0("Also hidden so that cell cannot be worked out: ", name_them("protect"), ".")),
    collapse = " ")
  if (!nzchar(note)) note <- NULL
  if (!nrow(drawn)) return(cat("\nAll categories have fewer than", k, "records.\n\n"))
  p <- ggplot(drawn, aes(n, reorder(level, n))) +
    geom_col(fill = okabe_ito[["blue"]], width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = fmt_n(n)), hjust = -0.2, size = 3, colour = "grey30") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(x = "Records", y = NULL, caption = note) +
    theme_intern(grid = "none") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank())
  print(p)
}

plot_numeric <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) < k) return(cat("\nFewer than", k, "valid values; not shown.\n\n"))
  breaks <- pretty(x, n = 20)
  bins <- tibble(bin = cut(x, breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
    count(bin, .drop = FALSE) |>
    mutate(mid = (head(breaks, -1) + tail(breaks, -1)) / 2,
           hidden = n > 0 & n < k)
  p <- ggplot(filter(bins, !hidden), aes(mid, n)) +
    geom_col(width = diff(breaks)[1] * 0.95, fill = okabe_ito[["blue"]]) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Records",
         caption = if (any(bins$hidden)) paste0("Bins with fewer than ", k, " records not drawn.")) +
    theme_intern(grid = "y")
  print(p)
  q <- quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), names = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("\nMean %s, standard deviation %s, quartiles %s / %s / %s.\n\n",
              signif(mean(x), 4), signif(sd(x), 4), signif(q[1], 4), signif(q[2], 4),
              signif(q[3], 4)))
}

walk(names(dat), function(v) {
  col <- cols[[v]] %||% list()
  x <- dat[[v]]
  cat("\n\n### ", v, if (nzchar(field(col, "label"))) paste0(": ", field(col, "label")), "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (nzchar(field(col, "description"))) cat(field(col, "description"), "\n\n")
  cat("Type `", field(col, "type"), "`", if (!is.null(col$units)) paste0(", units ", col$units),
      if (identical(col$display, "restricted")) ". **Restricted**: values are not shown." else ".",
      "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (identical(col$display, "restricted")) return(invisible())
  if (categorical(x)) plot_categorical(x, v) else if (is.numeric(x)) plot_numeric(x)
})
```

## Open questions

```{r}
#| label: todos
#| results: asis
todos <- c(
  if (!is.null(dict$todo)) paste0("- **Dataset**: ", gsub("\n", " ", dict$todo)),
  if (!is.null(tbl$todo)) paste0("- **Table**: ", gsub("\n", " ", tbl$todo)),
  unlist(map(tbl$columns, function(col)
    if (!is.null(col$todo)) paste0("- **", col$name, "**: ", gsub("\n", " ", col$todo)))))
if (length(todos)) cat(todos, sep = "\n") else cat("None. Every `todo` in the dictionary is resolved.\n")
```

## Reproducibility

Generated from `data-dict.yaml` (data-dict spec `r dict[["$version"]]`) and
`r tbl$source$parquet` on `r format(Sys.Date())` with R `r getRversion()`.
